name: GreebleFS Core Top Bars
description: Canonical shipped shell chrome presets that replace the old code-authored top bar catalog.

topBars.name: Command Center
topBars.description: The default shell workflow with launcher, tabs, and global utilities all in one chrome pass.

topBars.name: Floating Deck
topBars.description: The classic shell workflow with a floating command deck silhouette.

topBars.name: Orbital Glass
topBars.description: Glass-heavy chrome that keeps the full launcher workflow but leans into a softer capsule tab strip.

topBars.name: Focus Strip
topBars.description: A tighter, quieter top bar that keeps the explorer and command palette close without hauling every chrome control forward.

topBars.name: Dock Control Strip
topBars.description: Dock-optimized chrome with placement switching, compact settings, shell controls, and Explorer access kept close.

topBars.name: Launcher Rack
topBars.description: A launcher-first strip that turns the middle lane into a status surface instead of a tab strip.
